subject: Information Theory
title: Noise Cancellation
description: A micro-lesson that makes Noise Cancellation usable.

hook.text: Your headphones detect engine roar, generate the exact opposite wave, and cancel it. Destructive interference.

buildup.text: Active noise cancellation uses microphones to sample ambient noise and speakers to emit an anti-phase signal.

discovery.text: The anti-noise must be precisely timed. Even microseconds of delay reduce cancellation effectiveness.

twist.text: ANC works best on steady, low-frequency noise. Sudden sharp sounds are too fast for the system to cancel.

climax.text: Modern ANC combines feedforward and feedback paths, adapting hundreds of times per second to changing noise.

punchline.text: Fight sound with sound. Silence through addition.

quiz.question: How does active noise cancellation work?
options: It emits an anti-phase signal to cancel noise
